largest_accepted_samples.raw: 本游戏以策略玩法为主，玩家可以通过游戏内提供的资源和线索，结合自身长处变得更强，有益于玩家享受游戏乐趣，放松身心。游戏过程中，通过丰富的游戏内容，玩法和剧情等，让玩家身临其境，体会到现实生活中不一样的乐趣。帮助玩家在享受游戏乐趣进行放松与休息后，更好地投入现实中的工作与学习中。
largest_accepted_samples.translated: The game primarily focuses on strategic play. Players can become stronger by utilizing the resources and clues provided within the game, in conjunction with their own strengths, which enhances their enjoyment and relaxation. Throughout the gameplay, rich content, diverse playstyles, and engaging narratives immerse players, offering unique pleasures different from those in real life. After enjoying the game and taking a break, players can better engage in their real‑life work and studies.

largest_accepted_samples.raw: 本游戏画面为水墨风格，清新淡雅，弘扬我国美学文化。讲述了主角行侠仗义，惩奸除恶，帮助自己的门派发扬光大，造福百姓的故事。游戏中的背景皆为架空，不会与现实混淆。游戏中的玩法多为动脑的策略玩法，没有激烈刺激的战斗画面。游戏内所有内容都遵循相关法律法规。
largest_accepted_samples.translated: The game features a ink‑wash style graphics, fresh and elegant, upholding the aesthetic culture of our country. It tells the story of the protagonist practicing chivalry to help the innocent and punish villains, aiming to promote his sect's glory and benefit the people. The background settings in the game are all fictional and will not be confused with reality. The gameplay focuses on strategic thinking rather than intense combat scenes. All content within the game adheres to relevant laws and regulations.
